output.root_problem: Shipment notices sent from ORG-A to ORG-B (process P-1, handoff H-1) are being rejected by the carrier's system for at least two distinct, non-uniform mechanisms rather than one uniform cause: of the 3 logged rejects, 2 (N-1, N-2) are coded LOC_UNKNOWN and 1 (N-3) is coded EVENT_ORDER (E-01). The EVENT_ORDER reject is caused by the shipment notice/event being processed out of ORG-B's expected sequence over handoff H-1 (H-EVENT-SEQUENCING, supported by E-01) — not by notice-content errors or by a generically "flaky" carrier system.
output.requested_solution: Have an AI agent automatically detect and fix errors in rejected shipment notices and resubmit them (CL-01), premised on SH-REQ's claim that the carrier system is simply flaky (CL-02).
symptoms: 3 shipment notices (N-1, N-2, N-3) are currently sitting rejected and unresolved in the carrier reject log (E-01).
The reject reasons are non-uniform: 2 occurrences of LOC_UNKNOWN and 1 of EVENT_ORDER, not a single consistent category (E-01, F-01, F-02).
causal_chain: ORG-A sends shipment notices to ORG-B through handoff H-1 within process P-1.
For notice N-3, the notice/event is processed out of ORG-B's expected sequence (H-EVENT-SEQUENCING, supported by E-01).
ORG-B's carrier validation flags the out-of-sequence notice with reason EVENT_ORDER (E-01).
For notices N-1 and N-2, carrier validation independently flags reason LOC_UNKNOWN, a mechanism not yet attributed to any evidence-supported cause (E-01).
Result: 3 shipment notices remain rejected under two distinct reason codes, with no single uniform 'flaky system' or generic content-error pattern (E-01, F-01, F-02).

assumptions.statement: The out-of-sequence processing mechanism observed for N-3 is assumed to be the general cause of future EVENT_ORDER rejects, not a one-off.
Handoff H-1 is assumed to be the channel through which notice/event ordering is determined, even though H-1's semantic_validity/delivery_status fields do not record sequencing details.
The 3-record reject log sample is assumed representative of the true reject-reason distribution despite DA-REJ completeness being UNKNOWN.
